paper.title_en: Joule-Thomson Effect and Geodesic Structure of Charged AdS Black Holes in f(R,T) Coupled with Nonlinear Electrodynamics
paper.abstract_en: We herein study both the Joule-Thomson (JT) expansion process and the geodesic properties of a charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) black hole arising in modified gravity with nonlinear electrodynamic (NLED) sources. Our thermodynamic study reveals that the black hole charge has the most pronounced impact on the JT behaviour. The nonlinear electromagnetic sector together with the modified gravity parameters introduces further corrections to the inversion temperature and the associated cooling characteristics. At astrophysically relevant distances, the geometry closely reproduces expected outcomes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究f(R,T)修正引力与非线性电动力学耦合下的带电AdS黑洞，涉及Joule-Thomson膨胀与测地线结构，属于修正引力范畴，并涉及黑洞热力学；理论推导与热力学分析结合，具备一定阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: f(R,T)与非线性电动力学耦合下带电AdS黑洞的Joule-Thomson效应与测地线结构
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在此研究源于具有非线性电动力学（NLED）源的修正引力的带电反德西特（AdS）黑洞的Joule-Thomson（JT）膨胀过程与测地线性质。我们的热力学研究表明，黑洞电荷对JT行为的影响最为显著。非线性电磁部分与修正引力参数一起，对转化温度及相关冷却特性引入进一步修正。在天体物理相关距离上，几何结构很好地再现了预期结果。
